denominators.microbenchmark: Each iteration select maximum phase-duration rank, divide by SAME rank and iteration trace-on operation span; average iterations then 3 runs. Pre/post can select different ranks; do not add them.
denominators.e2e: Same-rank same-GPU-step durations; average rank ratios within each window then 3 windows. Union explicitly merged; component sums can have small overlap.
denominators.post_partition: Select max-post rank each iteration and divide its three subintervals by its own post duration; sum=100%.
